update.available: A new version of SocAlytics is available.
update.required: SocAlytics is updating to the version this server requires. Unsaved input on this screen is lost; uploads continue after the update.
update.reloadRequired: Reload SocAlytics to continue. This server requires a newer version.

connectivity.connectionRequired: A connection is required. SocAlytics shows no data and queues no actions while the platform is not reachable.
connectivity.unreachable: The platform is not reachable. Actions that change data are disabled until it is reachable again.

notPermitted: You are not permitted to open this page.
